title: Nanobanana respects the safety setting
summary:
A garden-tending day: fewer blocked image prompts and duplicate apps, a new look, a more direct Polly, and clearer Seed-tier criteria.

Nanobanana no longer adds safety instructions to image prompts. The extra prompt pre-check runs only with `safe=true`, while Vertex AI uses stricter filtering for those requests. Creative prompts without that setting should encounter less unnecessary blocking.

A catalog cleanup reduced roughly 2,300 rows to 619 while retaining newer submissions. The app parser also deduplicates names case-insensitively, and generated descriptions get a more consistent format.

Pollinations and Enter gained new logos, icons, social previews, and theme colors. Pages now set more accurate canonical URLs and search metadata, while community diary summaries no longer repeat their headlines.

highlights.title: A new Pollinations look
highlights.text: Pollinations and Enter have refreshed logos, icons, colors, and social preview images. [Visit Pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Polly gets to the point
highlights.text: Polly’s updated Discord guidance favors short, direct answers and covers more questions about Pollinations models, authentication, the SDK, images, and TTS. [Join the community chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).
